verdict.summary: The change correctly attributes a successfully released unsafe review/fix claim to the existing `unsafe-claim` defer category before continuing. This prevents `finish_pending()` from misclassifying the post-claim refusal as a lane-qualified pre-claim defer, while preserving the distinct fail-loud `unsafe-claim-release-failed` path and its lane error. The added self-test is non-vacuous: it covers both release outcomes, exact shared and fix-lane histogram buckets, absence of fallback/double-counting, lane health, and zero-dispatch ledger behavior. No trust check is weakened and no new token, permission, workflow-injection, or default-allow surface is introduced.
